scanNote:
GRAMMAR 14-BET. Unit 3 — o'rin predloglari va some/any.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 5-mashq (8 predlog), 6-mashq (10 savol-javob), 7-mashq (8 predlog), 8-mashq (10 ta a/an/some/any) — jami 36 ta javob.

⚠ 7-MAShQNING ENG QIYIN BANDI (7-band) SURATNI KESIB TEKShIRDIM: 'It is next to / IN FRONT OF the desk.' Suratda stul stolga QARAB turibdi (orqasi bizga qaragan) — ya'ni u stolning OLDIDA. Javob 'in front of' TO'G'RI.
  ⚠ 5-band ham shu suratdan: guldon deraza OLDIDAGI stol ustida — 'in front of the window'.

⚠ 5-MAShQ — RO'YXATDA 6 SO'Z, 8 BO'ShLIQ: kitob 'One of the prepositions is used more than once' deb ogohlantirgan. Bu yerda 'ON' uch marta ishlatiladi (stol ustida, devorlarda, divanda).

⚠ 6-MAShQ — 'IN' yoki 'ON':
  IN — ichida: in the study, in the kitchen, in the oven, in the vase, in the bathroom
  ON — yuzasida: on the table, on the wall, on the balcony, on the floor, on the bed
  ⚠ Balkon 'ON' oladi, chunki u ochiq YUZA hisoblanadi — 'in the balcony' xato.

⚠ 8-MAShQ — SOME/ANY va A/AN:
  SOME — tasdiq gapda ko'plik: some pictures, some pillows, some curtains
  ANY  — inkor gapda ko'plik: any posters, any flowers, any mirrors
  A/AN — birlik: a bed, a sofa, a lamp, a chair
  ⚠ Naqsh takrorlanadi: 'There ARE some ... but there AREN'T any ...' va 'There IS a ... but there ISN'T a ...'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and fill in the correct preposition. One of the prepositions is used more than once.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va to'g'ri predlogni qo'ying. Predloglardan biri bir necha marta ishlatiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ishlatiladigan predloglar: on, in, under, behind, next to, in front of

RASMDA: yog'och shipli mehmonxona. Chap tomonda zinapoya,
o'rtada oq divan, uning oldida shishali dumaloq stol,
stol ustida o'simlik, stol ostida gilamcha,
o'ng tomonda kamin va uning yonida chiroq bilan stol,
devorlarda ramkali rasmlar, divanda yostiqchalar.

MASHQ SIRI: 'One of the prepositions is used more than once'
— demak bittasi takrorlanadi. Bu 'on': stol USTIDA, devorlarDA,
divanDA — uchala holatda ham 'on'.

items.textEn: 1  There is a plant ____ the table.
items.whyUz: O'simlik shishali stol USTIDA turibdi.

items.textEn: 2  There is a fireplace ____ the room.
items.whyUz: Kamin xona ICHIDA. Xona uchun doim IN.

items.textEn: 3  There are stairs ____ the sofa.
items.whyUz: Zinapoya divanning ORQASIDA, orqa devorda.

items.textEn: 4  There is a rug ____ the table.
items.whyUz: Gilamcha stol OSTIDA, polda yotibdi.

items.textEn: 5  There are pictures ____ the walls.
items.whyUz: Devorga osilgan narsa uchun doim ON. Bu — takrorlanadigan predlog.

items.textEn: 6  There is a big table ____ the sofa.
items.whyUz: Shishali stol divanning OLDIDA turibdi.

items.textEn: 7  There is a lamp ____ the chair.
items.whyUz: Chiroq o'ng tomondagi stulning YONIDA turibdi.

items.textEn: 8  There are some cushions ____ the sofa.
items.whyUz: Yostiqchalar divan USTIDA. 'on' uchinchi marta ishlatildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions and answers, as in the example. Use the prepositions in and on.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunadagidek savol va javob yozing. Faqat 'in' va 'on' predloglaridan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  Mary?/study → Where's Mary? She's in the study.

UCH QARORNI QABUL QILASIZ:

  1) Where'S yoki Where ARE?
     bitta narsa/odam → Where's ... ?
     ko'p narsa/odam  → Where are ... ?

  2) He's / She's / It's / They're?
     erkak → He's,  ayol → She's
     narsa → It's,  ko'plik → They're

  3) IN yoki ON?
     IN — xona, idish ichida: in the study, in the kitchen,
          in the oven, in the vase, in the bathroom
     ON — yuzada: on the table, on the wall, on the balcony,
          on the floor, on the bed

Qisqartmalar: Where is → Where's, She is → She's,
They are → They're.

items.question: Where's Mary?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Mary — ayol → She's. Xona ichida → in.

items.question: Where are my books?
items.whyUz: 'books' ko'plik → Where ARE ... ? va THEY'RE. Stol yuzasida → on.

items.question: Where are the girls?
items.whyUz: 'girls' ko'plik → Where are ... ? Odamlar ham 'they'. Xona ichida → in.

items.question: Where's my dinner?
items.whyUz: 'dinner' — narsa → It's. Pech ICHIDA → in the oven. oven = duxovka.

items.question: Where are the posters?
items.whyUz: 'posters' ko'plik. Devorga osilgan → on.

items.question: Where's Jeff?
items.whyUz: Jeff — erkak → He's. Balkon YUZASIDA turadi → on the balcony (in EMAS).

items.question: Where's the carpet?
items.whyUz: Gilam — narsa → It's. Pol yuzasida → on the floor.

items.question: Where are the flowers?
items.whyUz: 'flowers' ko'plik. Guldon ICHIDA → in the vase.

items.question: Where's Sara?
items.whyUz: Sara — ayol → She's. Xona ichida → in.

items.question: Where's the pillow?
items.whyUz: Yostiq — narsa → It's. Karavot USTIDA → on the bed.

exercises.instructionEn: First, look at the picture. Then read the short text and underline the correct prepositions.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval rasmga qarang. So'ng qisqa matnni o'qib, to'g'ri predlogni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA: yotoqxona. Chap tomonda ikkita deraza va pardalar,
deraza oldida qora yozuv stoli, uning ustida gulli guldon,
stol oldida yog'och stul, o'ngda katta chiroq,
qizil ko'rpali karavot va ustida oq yostiqlar,
polda gilamcha, o'ng yuqorida devorda rasm.

MATN: 'There is a rug 1) in/on the floor. It is 2) behind/under
the bed. There is a lamp 3) next to/on the bed. There are some
pillows 4) in front of/on the bed. There is a vase 5) in/in front
of the window. There is a chair 6) in/under the room. It is
7) next to/in front of the desk. There is a picture 8) on/under
the wall.'

items.textEn: There is a rug 1) ____ the floor.
items.whyUz: Pol YUZASIDA → on the floor. 'in the floor' — polning ichida degani bo'lardi.

items.textEn: It is 2) ____ the bed.
items.whyUz: Gilamcha karavot OSTIDAN chiqib turibdi. Gilam hech qachon 'behind' bo'lmaydi.

items.textEn: There is a lamp 3) ____ the bed.
items.whyUz: Katta chiroq karavot YONIDAGI tumbada turibdi, karavot ustida emas.

items.textEn: There are some pillows 4) ____ the bed.
items.whyUz: Oq yostiqlar karavot USTIDA.

items.textEn: There is a vase 5) ____ the window.
items.whyUz: Guldon deraza OLDIDAGI stol ustida. 'in the window' — deraza tuynugida degani.

items.textEn: There is a chair 6) ____ the room.
items.whyUz: Xona uchun doim IN.

items.textEn: It is 7) ____ the desk.
items.whyUz: Yog'och stul stolning OLDIDA — unga qarab o'tiriladi.

items.textEn: There is a picture 8) ____ the wall.
items.whyUz: Devorga osilgan narsa uchun doim ON.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and fill in a, an, some, or any.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va a, an, some yoki any so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SAVOL BILAN HAL QILINADI:

  1) Ot BIRLIKMI yoki KO'PLIKMI?
  2) Gap TASDIQMI yoki INKORMI?

     BIRLIK  → a / an   (tasdiq ham, inkor ham)
     KO'PLIK + tasdiq → some
     KO'PLIK + inkor  → any

MATNDAGI QOLIP: 'There are/is ... BUT there aren't/isn't ...'
Har bir gapda bittasi bor, bittasi yo'q.

RASMDA: yotoqxona — yog'och shipli, devorlarda rasmlar,
katta karavot va yostiqlar, qizil kreslo, chiroq, pardalar,
polda gilam.

items.textEn: There are 1) ____ pictures on the walls...
items.whyUz: 'pictures' ko'plik, gap tasdiq → some.

items.textEn: ...but there aren't 2) ____ posters.
items.whyUz: 'posters' ko'plik, gap inkor → any.

items.textEn: There is 3) ____ bed in the room...
items.whyUz: 'bed' birlik, undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi → a.

items.textEn: ...but there isn't 4) ____ sofa.
items.whyUz: 'sofa' birlik → a. Inkor bo'lsa ham 'any' EMAS, chunki ot birlik.

items.textEn: There are 5) ____ pillows on the bed...
items.whyUz: 'pillows' ko'plik, gap tasdiq → some.

items.textEn: ...but there aren't 6) ____ flowers.
items.whyUz: 'flowers' ko'plik, gap inkor → any.

items.textEn: There is 7) ____ lamp...
items.whyUz: 'lamp' birlik, /l/ undosh tovush → a.

items.textEn: ...but there isn't 8) ____ chair.
items.whyUz: 'chair' birlik, /tʃ/ undosh tovush → a.

items.textEn: There are 9) ____ curtains...
items.whyUz: 'curtains' ko'plik, gap tasdiq → some.

items.textEn: ...but there aren't 10) ____ mirrors.
items.whyUz: 'mirrors' ko'plik, gap inkor → any.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 14-bet — qisqartmalar va predlog juftliklari.

groups.explanationUz: Og'zaki nutqda 'Where is' doim qisqaradi. 'Where are' esa qisqarmaydi.

groups.ruleUz: IN va ON — qaysi so'z bilan qaysi predlog
groups.explanationUz: Bu birikmalarni ALOHIDA emas, JUFTLIK holida yodlang.
Har biri o'z juftiga ega — juftlik bilan yodlash osonroq.

patterns.exampleEn: Where's Mary? — She's in the study.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birlik uchun Where's. Javobda ot takrorlanmaydi, olmosh ishlatiladi:
erkak → He's, ayol → She's, narsa → It's.

patterns.formula: Where are + ko'plik? — They're + predlog + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: Where are my books? — They're on the table.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik uchun Where are. Javob doim They're.

patterns.exampleEn: There are some pictures on the walls but there aren't any posters.
patterns.exampleUz: Devorlarda rasmlar bor, lekin plakatlar yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz:
'but' bilan bor va yo'q narsani bitta gapda taqqoslash.
Tasdiqda 'some', inkorda 'any'.

patterns.formula: There is a X. It is + predlog + Y.
patterns.exampleEn: There is a chair in the room. It is in front of the desk.
patterns.exampleUz: Xonada stul bor. U yozuv stolining oldida.
patterns.explanationUz:
Avval NIMA borligi, keyin alohida gapda QAYERDA ekani.
Ikkinchi gapda ot o'rniga 'It' keladi.
